'''Drilbian wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]]<ref name="SWCP" /> that originated from the [[Drilbia system/Legends|Drilbia system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Siene Symm]] loved exotic [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and Drilbian wine.<ref name="SWCP" />
